title: Noise Detection
description: Automatically highlights noise or artifacts in the image that may not be visible at first glance.

title: Crop tool
description: Manually crop the image or use fit crop to remove background-like edges. Adjust position, size, and sensitivity for precise results.

title: Brush
description: Paint on the image with adjustable brush size, opacity, and hardness. Eraser tool can remove painted areas.

title: Shape
description: Add vector shapes like rectangles, ellipses, or lines. Customize size, position, rotation, fill, stroke, and opacity.

title: Move
description: Move or zoom the canvas. Adjust movement speed and zoom sensitivity for smooth navigation.

title: Select
description: Select, move, or delete objects on the image. Use multi-select, select all, or deselect options for precise control.

title: Transform
description: Rotate, flip, or resize the image. Options for free rotation and dimension locking included.

title: Grayscale
description: Convert the image to shades of gray. Multiple conversion methods are available.

title: Dark/Light Converter
description: Switch the color scheme of the image between dark and light modes.

title: Background Removal
description: Remove image background automatically, manually, or by color selection. Adjust sensitivity for precise results.

title: Background Removal
description: Remove image background automatically, manually, or by color selection. Adjust sensitivity for precise results.

title: Background Removal
description: Remove image background automatically, manually, or by color selection. Adjust sensitivity for precise results.

title: Blur Area
description: Apply a blur effect to a selected rectangular area. Adjust size, rotation, strength, and edge fade.

title: Text
description: Add and edit text with font, size, color, opacity, style, rotation, and Z-index layering.

title: Magnify Area
description: Enlarge a specific area of the image. Customize zoom, radius, position, outline, and Z-index.

title: Frame
description: Add visual frames such as solid, browser, or phone frames. Customize color, width, and headers.

title: Presets
description: Save and apply image modification presets including rotate, flip, crop, resize, grayscale, and frame.

title: Export
description: Export images in different formats, set file quality and dimensions, preview, or copy to clipboard.

title: Color Eye Dropper
description: Pick a color from the image to use with tools like brush or background removal.
